correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 24-square legal rook complex with row caps (1,2,2,2) and six unit columns. Independent column-state and row-combinations enumerations gave 6309 nonempty faces, f=(24,225,1020,2250,2160,630). The stated 24-vertex toggle order gives 3105 disjoint Morse pairs, 27090 cover arrows, a complete acyclic topological sort, and exactly one critical 0-cell plus 98 critical 4-cells. This yields the integral wedge of 98 S4 directly, not merely mod-two Betti. Sum of capacities seven ensures every <6-rook face can be extended, so purity in dimension five and non-shellability are correctly qualified. No torsion.
